Bar that allows small children to enter!
Aug 2018 • Friends
It's been our most favorite place in town to hang out and enjoy great cocktails. However, we were so disappointed tonight as the bar allowed 3 small children (around 5,6 years old) entered the bar at quite late, 10pm. The kids then made so much noise and I have never seen the any bars that allows children to get in. We immediately gave our feedback to the bar manager but he seemed encourage that and had no problem with that. We would suggest the bar to change its policy as small children should never spend time in a bar, especially late at night.
